findings.element: Use bundled sample asset data (no upload needed)
click_path: Check Use bundled sample asset data (no upload needed)
findings.expected: The bundled sample loads successfully with the default settings.
findings.actual: With Min observations per id set to 36, loading the sample raises ValueError: insufficient data for ids: FUND_A, FUND_B, SP500_TR. The scenario goal fails, matching the Gate-1 wiring finding.
findings.fix_hint: Supply bundled data that satisfies the default observation requirement and verify sample loading with unchanged defaults.
fix_hints: Supply bundled data that satisfies the default observation requirement and verify sample loading with unchanged defaults.
Keep the sample path usable by default and provide an inline recovery action when validation fails, preserving the user's selections.
Make the bundled sample load succeed out of the box and show a clear success state with a CTA to Portfolio Builder or download YAML
Adjust the default 'Min observations per id' to match the bundled dataset, or update the dataset to have at least 36 observations.
Automatically update dependent fields (like 'Min observations per id') to compatible values when the bundled sample is toggled.
Ensure bundled sample has >=36 observations for all IDs, or reduce default min_observations threshold, or validate data before load attempt

findings.element: Tick “Use bundled sample data” on Stress Lab (or Scenario Grid) guidance
click_path: Navigate to Scenario Grid expecting the same one-click bundled example as Stress Lab
findings.expected: Scenario Grid offers an equally obvious bundled-sample path as Stress Lab for a complete example
findings.actual: Scenario Grid initial state shows only 'Upload Grid CSV' tab with status 'Provide a CSV to render the grid heatmap'; no bundled-sample checkbox observed on that surface
findings.fix_hint: Add a visible bundled-sample control on Scenario Grid or remove Scenario Grid from the home one-click claim so onboarding matches available affordances
fix_hints: Add a visible bundled-sample control on Scenario Grid or remove Scenario Grid from the home one-click claim so onboarding matches available affordances
Catch the data loading exceptions and render a user-friendly Streamlit warning or error message with actionable advice.
Replace technical traceback with plain-language explanation and suggested fix (e.g., 'Increase data history or lower min observations')
Implement application-level error handling that translates backend exceptions into user-facing messages
